The deliverable is complete: **`chip8_zai-glm-5.3-flash_01.html`** — a single self-contained file (448 lines, ~19 KB, no external resources), with the inline JavaScript passing a `node --check` syntax verification.

What it includes:

- **Interpreter core**: 4 KB memory, font set at `0x050`, ROM loaded at `0x200`; V0–VF, 16-bit I, PC, call stack (16 levels), delay/sound timers at 60 Hz.
- **Full 35-instruction set**: `00E0`, `00EE`, `1nnn`, `2nnn`, `3xkk`/`4xkk`, `5xy0`/`9xy0`, `6xkk`/`7xkk`, all 8xy* arithmetic/logic ops with VF carry/borrow flags (8xy6/8xyE shifts), `Annn`, `Bnnn`, `Cxkk` random, `Dxyn` XOR draw with VF collision, `Ex9E`/`ExA1` key tests, `Fx07/15/18/0A`, `Fx1E`, `Fx29`, `Fx33` BCD, `Fx55`/`Fx65`.

- **Controls**: Run, Pause, Single Step, Reset, ROM file loader, and an instructions-per-frame slider (1–20, default ~10).
- **Debugger panel**: live V0–VF, I, PC, stack contents, and the decoded current instruction (mnemonic disassembly), updated every frame/step.

Open the file in any browser, press **Run**, and steer the diamond with the on-screen keypad or the `qwer/asdf` keys (key 5=`s`, 6=`d`, 7=`w`, 8=`x`).
